before: A table that opened the body collapsed every empty hidden end-mark cell, so its first row fell to its minimum height.
after: The first paragraph of the document keeps its end-of-cell line, so the first row of such a table is at least one line tall. Shared document state and operations are unchanged.
reason: The change is confined to layout. Replicas compute the same layout from the same tree, and saved documents keep the same XML.
